fixture.note: Proposal render may show home selected; runtime starts with empty environment and no equipment selections.

outdoor_note: Catalog equipment ids are derived from exercises with non-empty equipment_all for the selected environment. Outdoor-eligible exercises in the draft catalog are bodyweight-only, so the checklist is empty; the user confirms bodyweight-only explicitly.

bodyweight_only.stores: equipment array cleared; not inferred from goal or avatar

constraints: environment is a required explicit choice: home, gym, or outdoor per training-profile schema.
Continue from equipment requires bodyweight_only or at least one selected equipment id when the environment has catalog items.
Outdoor requires explicit bodyweight_only because the derived equipment list is empty.
No load ranges, named equipment profiles, or inference from avatar, goal, or measurements.
Unavailable equipment is never silently required by this UI; only declared items are stored.
Return and language changes preserve the draft; exit discards unsaved changes.
persistence: In-memory draft in review mode only until private profile service exists.
